name: Gilfoyle
description: Conductor turns Claude Code into a structured engineering system. Instead of ad-hoc prompting, every task flows through a rigorous **Evaluate-Loop** with specialized agents, quality gates, and automatic recovery. It ships with 16+ agents, 36 skills, a 5-member Board of Directors for architectural decisions, DAG-based parallel execution, and a learning system that improves across projects.
